title: Maximum Subarray
hook: The famous Kadane's trick in 30 seconds 👀
problem: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum.
idea: If the running sum goes negative, drop it and restart.

steps.say: Sum was -2 → drop it, restart at 4 🔄
-1 hurts, but the sum stays positive

tip: Start best at nums[0] so all-negative arrays work
cta: Next: Climbing Stairs 🧩 Don't miss it!
